PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

6. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.

8. B — Ice melting to water

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

10. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

12. C — newton (N)
